Welcome to Langley Street. A quiet little neighborhood. Houses, people, pets, everything looks ordinary. Your first stop is Langley Street 23. Home to Marvin. Marvin believes someone, or something, is watching him. On Langley Street, that’s not the strangest thing to believe.
Langley Street 23 is a 5 row by 5 column slot.

Bet amount and balance are always displayed in the info bar at the bottom of the game view in the currency that the player has chosen. This information is always available throughout the gaming session. Winnings are displayed in the selected currency in the middle of the info bar at the bottom of the game view when playing in landscape mode, and at the top of the game view when playing in portrait mode.
Langley Street 23 has 5 columns and 5 rows with 35 paylines. The RTP for all paylines is the same and the RTP of the game is defined in the game rules.
Three or more bonus symbols in normal mode trigger the bonus game with bonus spins. There are two bonus modes that a player can trigger, sticky wilds or sticky mystery bonus.

Langley Street 23 is a 5 reels, 5 rows slot with spinning reels and 35 paylines.
The minimum bet is __MINBADEFBMODE__, and the maximum bet is __MAXBADEFBMODE__.
Each bet is __CPBB__ coins.

Wins begin with the first leftmost reel and only pay from left to right on consecutive reels. No gaps between the reels are allowed. Only the longest payline per active payline is paid out. An active payline is defined as the longest winning symbol combination.
A game round starts on the selected bet level when the player hits the Spin button.
The game can be played automatically by activating Auto Spin. Hold down the Spin button or use the Auto Spin button to set the number of game rounds to be played automatically.

The game can be played automatically by activating Auto Spin. Hold down the spin button or use the Auto Spin button to set the bet level, loss limit and the number of game rounds to be played automatically.
Winnings and winning combinations are paid out according to the Paytable.
Winnings are presented in the player's currency or in coins. The player can change preference in Settings.
Winnings are presented in the player's currency.
The game is played in two modes; Normal mode and Bonus mode with Bonus Spins.
The wild symbol substitutes for any symbol except bonus, multiplier adder and VHS tape symbols. The wild symbol may land with a multiplier. A payline of all wilds pays as the highest value symbol.

Wild, Expanding Wild, and Mystery symbols might have a multiplier value when they land on the gamegrid. Possible multiplier values are:
Wild: 2x, 3x, 5x, 8x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, or 100x. Expanding Wild: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, or 100x. Mystery: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, or 100x.
There are 4 features locked at the start of the game: mystery, expanding wild, cloning wild and surveillance TV.
VHS tapes can only land on reel 5 and are added to the TV. The state of the surveillance and CRT TV is kept between game rounds for each bet level.
VHS tapes cannot land during re-spins.
Feature symbols have a different probability of landing depending on how many VHS tapes have been collected.
The probability of triggering the bonus game is different depending on how many VHS tapes have been collected.
VHS tapes have different probability of landing depending on how many VHS tapes have been collected.
When a total of 6 VHS tapes have been collected, the mystery symbol is unlocked. A mystery re-spin is awarded.
A mystery re-spin is a re-spin with at least 1 guaranteed mystery symbol.
A mystery re-spin is a re-spin with at least 3 guaranteed mystery symbols.
The mystery symbols reveal the same payout or wild symbols.
The mystery symbol can have a multiplier.
Each spin, there is a chance that at least 1 payout symbol type becomes mystery symbols for that spin. When the reels stop, all mystery symbols become the same chosen symbol.
When a total of 12 VHS tapes have been collected, the expanding wild symbol is unlocked. An expanding wild re-spin is awarded.
An expanding wild re-spin is a re-spin with at least 1 guaranteed expanding wild symbol.

The expanding wild symbol expands to cover the entire reel and has two multiplier values. When all reels have landed, one of the two multiplier values is chosen and applied to the wild. If a symbol with a multiplier is present on the same reel as an expanding wild when it expands, the multiplier values get added to the expanding wild.
The expanding wild substitutes for any symbol except the bonus, multiplier adder and VHS tape symbols and may include a multiplier.
When a total of 18 VHS tapes have been collected, the cloning wild symbol is unlocked. A cloning wild re-spin is awarded.
A cloning wild re-spin is a re-spin with at least 1 guaranteed cloning wild symbol.
A cloning wild re-spin is a re-spin with at least 3 guaranteed cloning wild symbols.

Cloning wild symbols can land on reels 2, 3, 4 and 5. The cloning wild symbol creates a wild symbol in its position and in the adjacent position to the left. The cloning wild may have a multiplier. If it does, this multiplier will also be applied to the new wild symbols.
If the cloning wild clones over a wild symbol or a expanding wild symbol, it instead adds its multiplier value to that symbol. If the cloning wild does not have a multiplier, it still adds +1.
If the cloning wild clones over a mystery symbol that has turned into a payout symbol, it turns it into a wild symbol. If the cloning wild has a multiplier value it is added to the symbol.
Each spin, there is a chance that at least 1 payout symbol type become cloning wild symbols for that spin on reels 2, 3, 4 and 5.
When a total of 24 VHS tapes have been collected, the surveillance TV feature is unlocked and replaces the CRT TV. A re-spin with a guaranteed bonus game trigger is also awarded.

The surveillance TV is split up into 4 screens. Each screen is paired with a matching VHS tape. When a VHS tape lands, there is a chance that it lights up a part of the image of the screen it belongs to. It may also collect an already collected piece, meaning that nothing happens, and lastly, it may immediately add the remaining pieces of the image.
Every time the surveillance TV collects a VHS tape, there is an equal chance that the corresponding feature will trigger.

When a screen's image is completed one of the following features are awarded:
Completing the top left screen triggers the mystery re-spin. Completing the top right screen triggers the expanding wild re-spin. Completing the bottom left screen triggers the cloning wild re-spin. Completing the bottom right screen triggers a re-spin with guaranteed bonus trigger.
Unlocked feature progression and the state of the surveillance TV is kept between game rounds for each bet level.
The surveillance TV's respective screen is reset after its feature triggers.

Three or more bonus symbols trigger the bonus game with bonus spins. The bonus game starts at the end of the game round when there are no more winning combinations in view.
- 3 bonus symbols trigger the bonus game with 8 bonus spins. - 4 bonus symbols trigger the bonus game with 10 bonus spins. - 5 bonus symbols trigger the bonus game with 12 bonus spins.
There are no VHS tapes in the bonus games.
All feature symbols are unlocked in the bonus game.
Before the bonus spins begin, either sticky mystery or sticky wild bonus mode is awarded.
Landing a bonus symbol in the bonus game adds +1 bonus spin.
In the sticky wild bonus mode, all wild and expanding wild symbols are persistent during bonus spins.
In the sticky wild bonus mode, the multiplier adder increases or adds a multiplier value to one or more wild or expanding wild symbols.
In the sticky mystery bonus mode, all mystery symbols are persistent during bonus spins. The mystery symbol becomes a symbol each spin.
In the sticky mystery bonus mode, the multiplier adder increases or adds a multiplier value to one or more mystery symbols.
In both bonus modes, there is a chance that the multiplier adder increases the bonus counter with +2 bonus spins.
In both bonus modes, there is a chance that the multiplier adder increases the bonus counter with +1 bonus spin.
The Multiplier Adder may target multiple symbols and increase the multiplier value of each target by one of the following amounts: 1x, 2x, 3x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x.
Winnings are paid out at the end of a game round.
The maximum total win in a game round is capped at __TBB__ the placed bet.
A game round is immediately ended when the win cap is reached, and the wins collected so far will be paid out.

The maximum total win is accumulated across all wins in the game round and can be obtained from one big win or several smaller wins. The probability to hit the maximum total win in the game is __MWP__.
No bets can be changed during a game round.
The theoretical return to player (RTP) is __RTP__.
In the event of malfunction all bets and wins are void.

The X-iter feature offers several different game modes.
Project: Memory wipe: Guarantees a game round with at least 2 expanding wilds at the cost of __X05_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet. The bonus mode can not be triggered.
Super bonus: Guarantees a game round with entry to the bonus game with 5 bonus symbols at the cost of __X05_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
Sticky wild bonus: Guarantees a game round with entry to the bonus game with the sticky wild mode at the cost of __X05_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
Bonus: Guarantees a game round with entry to the bonus game at the cost of __X04_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
Sticky mystery bonus: Guarantees a game round with entry the bonus game with the sticky mystery mode at the cost of __X04_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.

The Langley Files: Guarantees a game round with one of the following features: cloning wild spin, mystery symbol spin, expanding wild spin or bonus trigger. The cost is __X03_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
Mega hunt: Buy a game round with a higher chance to trigger a Bonus game. Cost is __X02_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
Mega hunt: One spin with 6 times the chance to trigger the bonus game, compared to the bonus probability when all features have been unlocked, at the cost of __X02_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
Mega hunt: One spin with 8 times the average chance to trigger the bonus game, at the cost of __X01_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
Bonus hunt: Buy a game round with a high chance to trigger a Bonus game. Cost is __X01_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
Bonus hunt: One spin with 3 times the chance to trigger the bonus game, compared to the bonus probability when all features have been unlocked, at the cost of __X01_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
Bonus hunt: One spin with 4 times the average chance to trigger the bonus game, at the cost of __X01_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
An X-iter feature is purchased by pressing the X-iter button, selecting X-iter mode showing the cost in the player's currency, and pressing the Spin button.
The X-iter features can only be activated in the base game.
The theoretical return to player (RTP) for all X-iter game modes are __RTP__.
The minimum X-iter cost is __MINBABMODE__, the maximum X-iter cost is __MAXBABMODE__.
All game rules apply in X-iter mode.
Last updated 2026-06-01
